{{Quote|You've got skill. But it takes more than fast servomotors and bad programming to kill a Jedi.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="LD">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Lightsaber Duels]]''</ref>}}
The '''EG-5 Jedi Hunter droid''', also called the '''EG droid''', was a model of [[battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] created by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Its sole purpose was to eliminate [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Two members of the line were [[EG-05]] and [[EG-07]].

==Overview==
[[File:DrawingtheEG-05Droidstep1.jpg|thumb|left|150px|EG-5 droid.]]
The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] appeared to be roughly [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] in shape, with skeletal features similar to that of [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Its helmeted head contained two red [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]] and its body was coated in red color. Its qualities included incredible speed, dexterity, and the ability to wield [[Jar'Kai/Legends|two]] [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] with perfect form.

==History==
As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] raged on, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] were losing their support in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], with it being said that battles were won by the Republic because of a single [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] is worth a hundred droids. To turn the tide of the war in their favor, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]] ordered the creation of an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]-droid designed to hunt down and eliminate Jedi.<ref name="LD:Prima Guide">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Lightsaber Duels: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Lightsaber Duels'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

While the EG-5 was tested on its own prototypes, [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]] was skeptical that a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] would be able to reliably defeat a Jedi. However, being pleased to have another weapon in his arsenal, Dooku decided to nonetheless test its skills.<ref name="LD:Prima Guide">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Lightsaber Duels: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Lightsaber Duels'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref><ref name="LD" />

Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was sent to destroy a droid factory controlled by the Separatists, where he encountered and the lightsaber-wielding droid. After a fierce [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], Skywalker managed to slice into its shoulder, allowing him to unleash an onslaught of slashes before throwing it into an electrode, causing the droid to explode.<ref name="LD" />
